timeline.idleHint: As soon as a workflow starts, its bar grows here live.
timeline.trackLabel: Run timeline. Arrow keys move between runs, Enter opens the selected run.
timeline.subRowsCapped: More runs overlap here than {{rows}} rows can show — some bars share a row.
timeline.density: {{runs}} finished runs in this window, {{failed}} failed. Older runs are counted per interval instead of drawn individually: column height = runs, tick below the line = failures (red) or cancellations (grey). Pick a shorter window for individual bars.
timeline.densityCapped: More than {{runs}} finished runs in this window — the counts are based on the newest {{runs}}. Older runs are counted per interval: column height = runs, tick below the line = failures (red) or cancellations (grey). Pick a shorter window for individual bars.

drilldown.quarantineConfirm: Quarantine “{{name}}”? This disables the workflow so no trigger can start it again, and cancels every running execution.
drilldown.quarantinePartial: Workflow disabled, but the running executions could not be cancelled. Use “Cancel all runs” to retry that step.
